C(3) G(7) E(5) $\rightarrow +4, -2$
H(8) J(10) I(9) $\rightarrow +2, -1$
L(12) P(16) N(14) $\rightarrow +4, -2$
S(19) U(21) T(20) $\rightarrow +2, -1$
Pattern alternate chal raha hai. Toh next group mein $+4, -2$ gap hona chahiye.
Options mein Y(25) C(3) A(1) check karo $\rightarrow 25+4=29 (C)$, $3-2=1 (A)$. Bilkul set!

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 1, 2, 4, 7, 13, 24, 44, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Ye series dekhte hi Tribonacci ki smell aani chahiye. Pichle teen number jud ke agla ban raha hai.

Ninja Technique:
$\rightarrow 1+2+4 = 7$
$\rightarrow 2+4+7 = 13$
$\rightarrow 4+7+13 = 24$
$\rightarrow 7+13+24 = 44$
$\rightarrow 13+24+44 = 81$.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find out the correct alternative that when filled in the blanks in the same sequence will make the series logically complete. 

J _ S X _ W U T N S _ P _ O Y L R K A _
questions_hin.s_hi:
Method: Total 20 spaces hain. Inhe 5 groups of 4 mein baat lo, ya columns banakar compare karo:
Col 1: J, _, N, _, R. Series is J(10), L(12), N(14), P(16), R(18). (Yani +2 chal raha hai). Blanks = L, P.
Col 2: _, W, S, O, K. Series is A(27), W(23), S(19), O(15), K(11). (Yani -4 chal raha hai). Blank = A.
Col 3: S, U, _, Y, A. Series +2 mein hai. Blank = W.
Col 4: X, T, P, L, _. Series -4 mein hai. Blank = H.
Chronological order of blanks padho: A, L, W, P, H.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 11, 14, 31, 14, 16, 34, 17, 18, 37, ?, 20, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Series bohot lambi hai, iska matlab isme 3-3 ke chunks (triplets) hain. Pattern ko break kar!

Ninja Technique:
Triplets mein divide kar:
(11, 14, 31) $\rightarrow$ (14, 16, 34) $\rightarrow$ (17, 18, 37) $\rightarrow$ (?, 20, ?)
Har triplet ke elements compare kar:
1st element: $11 \xrightarrow{+3} 14 \xrightarrow{+3} 17 \xrightarrow{+3} 20$
2nd element: $14 \xrightarrow{+2} 16 \xrightarrow{+2} 18 \xrightarrow{+2} 20$
3rd element: $31 \xrightarrow{+3} 34 \xrightarrow{+3} 37 \xrightarrow{+3} 40$
Toh missing numbers honge 20 aur 40. Option D correct hai.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the next element that replace the ? Logically. 

10, 21, 54, 153, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Method: Dekh bhai, yahan bhi difference ka hi khel hai.
21 - 10 = 11
54 - 21 = 33
153 - 54 = 99
Differences dekho: 11, 33, 99. Har term $\times 3$ ho raha hai. Toh agla difference $99 \times 3 = 297$ hoga.
153 + 297 = 450.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

30, 22, 36, 75, 178, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Ninja Technique (Top Tier Trap): Ye question CGL ke best level traps mein se ek hai. Direct difference se brain freeze ho jayega. JSM / Multiplication base lagana padega.

Method:
30 $\times$ 0.5 + 7 = 15 + 7 = 22
22 $\times$ 1 + 14 = 36
36 $\times$ 1.5 + 21 = 54 + 21 = 75
75 $\times$ 2 + 28 = 150 + 28 = 178

Multiplier 0.5 se badh raha hai, aur addition 7 ke multiples mein hai.
Agla term = 178 $\times$ 2.5 + 35.
178 ka 2.5 times = $178 \times \frac{5}{2} = 445$.
445 + 35 = 480.

questions_hin.q_hi:
The series given below contains a sequence of numbers. Accordingly identify the incorrect combination. 

5, 10, 40, 46, 180, 185, 741
questions_hin.s_hi:
Method (Exam Approach): Bhai series ko chote tukdo mein tod kar relation dhundho.
Pattern ye chalna chahiye tha: +5, $\times$ 4, +5, $\times$ 4.
Check karte hain:
5 + 5 = 10
10 $\times$ 4 = 40
40 + 5 = 45 (Lekin series mein 46 likha hai. So 46 is WRONG).
Agar 45 hota, toh next: 45 $\times$ 4 = 180 (Sahi hai).
180 + 5 = 185 (Sahi hai).
185 $\times$ 4 = 740 (Lekin series mein 741 likha hai. So 741 is WRONG).
Isliye galat combination 46 aur 741 ka hai.
